claim: Nácar-2 now has corrected engine-agnostic semantic visual LOD1/LOD2 foundations with measured extent preserved and shared collision kept independent. Runtime switching, water physics and target-hardware performance are not claimed.

LOD0.policy: full engineering blockout exterior + interior/service detail; collision excluded

LOD1.policy: exterior silhouette + propulsion/control surfaces + cheap hydrophone/guards/frame/nav lights; cockpit/service/cargo microdetail removed

LOD2.policy: low-poly hull/prow/stern/canopy/sonar/fins + two ducted thrusters + guards + hydrophone identity ring

incident_and_control.defect: Initial LOD2 rebuilt the pressure hull from object.dimensions of a source cylinder rotated 90 degrees, reinterpreting its 9.4 m longitudinal dimension as vertical height; LOD2 became 29.3 percent taller than LOD0.
incident_and_control.control: derive hull and thruster proxy extents from evaluated source world-space AABB rather than local dimensions

reason_not_done: Production engine EXO-012 remains unresolved; runtime LOD switching, physics, collision, target-hardware performance and human GATE-ART are still mandatory.
